import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(13)
n = 1000
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (3, 10))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df['group'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k]
# Two overlay DataFrames.
m1 = 150
k1 = rng.integers(0, 3, m1)
df2 = pd.DataFrame(centers[k1] + rng.normal(0, 1, (m1, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df2['group'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k1]
m2 = 100
k2 = rng.integers(0, 3, m2)
df3 = pd.DataFrame(centers[k2] + rng.normal(0, 1, (m2, 10)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(10)])
df3['group'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k2]

steps.name: count base pixels
steps.eval: await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__pixelsBase = n

steps.name: wait for df2 overlay XY
steps.until: (() => { const ov = a.layers.find(l => l.kind === 'point-overlay'); return ov && (a.overlayFilled.get(ov.id) ?? 0) >= (a.overlayNKept.get(ov.id) ?? 1); })()

steps.name: wait for df3 overlay XY
steps.until: (() => { const ovs = a.layers.filter(l => l.kind === 'point-overlay'); return ovs.length === 2 && ovs.every(ov => (a.overlayFilled.get(ov.id) ?? 0) >= (a.overlayNKept.get(ov.id) ?? 1)); })()

steps.name: verify two overlays have different symbol codes
steps.report: { symbols: a.layers.filter(l => l.kind === 'point-overlay').map(l => ({ name: l.name, symbol: l.symbol })) }

steps.name: count pixels with both overlays — must exceed base
steps.eval: await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__pixelsBothOverlays = n
steps.report: { pixelsBase: window.__pixelsBase, pixelsBothOverlays: window.__pixelsBothOverlays, diff: window.__pixelsBothOverlays - window.__pixelsBase }

steps.name: hide first overlay and verify pixel count drops
steps.eval: const ov1 = a.layers.filter(l => l.kind === 'point-overlay')[0]; a.updateLayer(ov1.id, { visible: false });

steps.name: count pixels with only second overlay
steps.eval: await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__pixelsOneOverlay = n

steps.name: restore first overlay
steps.eval: const ov1 = a.layers.filter(l => l.kind === 'point-overlay')[0]; a.updateLayer(ov1.id, { visible: true });

steps.name: export html with overlays
steps.eval: a.htmlExportOpen = true; a.exportHtml({ tooltipColumns: [], linkColumn: -1, maxChars: 100, embedImages: false, samplePct: 100 })
